prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal region of Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain as it gently ascends through a dense forest of dark, leafless trees. Snowflakes fall steadily, creating a soft white blanket over the ground and rocks, while the dim light of the moon casts faint shadows that dance across the path. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the trail as it winds through the natural landscape. As the journey continues, the path narrows and becomes more rugged, with patches of exposed rock and roots peeking through the snow. The surrounding environment is quiet and serene, with no other individuals in sight, emphasizing the solitude of the trek. The camera occasionally pans slightly to the left and right, revealing the dense forest and the steep, snow-dusted slopes on either side of the trail. The lighting remains consistently low, with the snow reflecting the minimal ambient light, giving the scene a muted palette of whites, grays, and dark greens. The atmosphere is calm and undisturbed, with the only movement being the steady progression of the camera along the winding, snowy path.
